configurations.name: hiveblot-api-cloud
runtimeArgs: cd api && set -a && . ./.env.cloud && set +a && ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8010

configurations.name: hiveblot-api-local-8010
runtimeArgs: cd api && INTERNAL_API_KEY=$(grep '^INTERNAL_API_KEY' .env.cloud | cut -d= -f2-) ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8010

configurations.name: hiveblot-api-demo
runtimeArgs: cd api && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && INTERNAL_API_KEY=$(grep '^INTERNAL_API_KEY' .env.cloud | cut -d= -f2-) WBM_LLM_BACKEND=${WBM_LLM_BACKEND:-claude_cli} WBM_MODEL=${WBM_MODEL:-sonnet} ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8010
